package domain

import (
	"errors"
	"strings"

	"github.com/google/uuid"
)

const StudentPlanningReadinessSnapshotSchema = "student-planning-readiness-snapshot.v1"

type StudentPlanningReadinessStateRef struct {
	Kind    string `json:"kind"`
	Version int64  `json:"version"`
}

type StudentPlanningReadinessStackValues struct {
	State  string    `json:"state"`
	Values *[]string `json:"values,omitempty"`
}

type StudentPlanningReadinessLanguage struct {
	Code       string `json:"code,omitempty"`
	Provenance string `json:"provenance"`
	Source     string `json:"source,omitempty"`
}

type StudentPlanningReadinessProfile struct {
	DirectionCode          *string                             `json:"direction_code,omitempty"`
	SelfAssessedExperience *string                             `json:"self_assessed_experience,omitempty"`
	KnownStacks            StudentPlanningReadinessStackValues `json:"known_stacks"`
	DesiredStacks          StudentPlanningReadinessStackValues `json:"desired_stacks"`
	PreferredLanguage      *StudentPlanningReadinessLanguage   `json:"preferred_language,omitempty"`
	ContentLanguage        *StudentPlanningReadinessLanguage   `json:"content_language,omitempty"`
	WeeklyMinutes          *int                                `json:"weekly_minutes,omitempty"`
	PreferredPace          *string                             `json:"preferred_pace,omitempty"`
}

type StudentPlanningReadinessLearningIntent struct {
	Code       string `json:"code"`
	Source     string `json:"source"`
	Provenance string `json:"provenance"`
}

// StudentPlanningReadinessActivePath is observational only: it is emitted
// only for the exact selected path that is currently ACTIVE.
type StudentPlanningReadinessActivePath struct {
	LearningPathID string `json:"learning_path_id"`
	Version        int64  `json:"version"`
	CourseID       string `json:"course_id"`
	GoalCode       string `json:"goal_code"`
	Status         string `json:"status"`
}

// StudentPlanningReadinessSnapshot is the intentionally small Planner input.
// It is not an onboarding write model and contains no raw model output.
type StudentPlanningReadinessSnapshot struct {
	Schema         string                                  `json:"schema"`
	StudentID      string                                  `json:"student_id"`
	StateRef       StudentPlanningReadinessStateRef        `json:"state_ref"`
	LearningIntent *StudentPlanningReadinessLearningIntent `json:"learning_intent,omitempty"`
	Profile        StudentPlanningReadinessProfile         `json:"profile"`
	ActivePath     *StudentPlanningReadinessActivePath     `json:"active_path,omitempty"`
}

// StudentPlanningReadinessProvenance is the narrow accepted-slot evidence
// needed to determine whether a language was explicitly accepted.
type StudentPlanningReadinessProvenance struct {
	SlotCode               string
	CodeValue              *string
	StacksValue            *[]string
	AcceptedDraftVersion   int64
	AcceptedProfileVersion *int64
	Origin                 StudentOnboardingTurnOrigin
}

// StudentPlanningReadinessSource is read by the adapter in one consistent
// snapshot. An active draft wins deterministically over a finalized profile.
type StudentPlanningReadinessSource struct {
	StudentID  string
	Draft      *StudentOnboardingDraft
	Profile    *StudentOnboarding
	Provenance []StudentPlanningReadinessProvenance
	ActivePath *StudentPlanningReadinessActivePath
}

func BuildStudentPlanningReadinessSnapshot(input StudentPlanningReadinessSource) (StudentPlanningReadinessSnapshot, error) {
	input.StudentID = strings.TrimSpace(input.StudentID)
	if _, err := uuid.Parse(input.StudentID); err != nil {
		return StudentPlanningReadinessSnapshot{}, errors.New("invalid planning readiness student")
	}
	var finalizedDraftVersion int64
	if input.Draft != nil {
		draft, err := NormalizeStudentOnboardingDraft(*input.Draft)
		if err != nil || draft.StudentID != input.StudentID {
			return StudentPlanningReadinessSnapshot{}, errors.New("invalid planning readiness draft")
		}
		if draft.Status == StudentOnboardingDraftStatusDraft && draft.Version > 0 {
			return buildPlanningReadinessFromDraft(input.StudentID, draft, input.Provenance, input.ActivePath)
		}
		if draft.Status == StudentOnboardingDraftStatusCompleted && draft.CompletedProfileVersion != nil &&
			input.Profile != nil && *draft.CompletedProfileVersion == input.Profile.Version {
			finalizedDraftVersion = draft.Version
		}
	}
	if input.Profile != nil {
		profile, err := NormalizeStudentOnboarding(*input.Profile)
		if err != nil || profile.StudentID != input.StudentID {
			return StudentPlanningReadinessSnapshot{}, errors.New("invalid planning readiness profile")
		}
		return buildPlanningReadinessFromProfile(input.StudentID, profile, input.Provenance, finalizedDraftVersion, input.ActivePath)
	}
	return normalizeStudentPlanningReadiness(StudentPlanningReadinessSnapshot{
		Schema: StudentPlanningReadinessSnapshotSchema, StudentID: input.StudentID,
		StateRef: StudentPlanningReadinessStateRef{Kind: "none", Version: 0},
		Profile: StudentPlanningReadinessProfile{
			KnownStacks: unansweredPlanningReadinessStacks(), DesiredStacks: unansweredPlanningReadinessStacks(),
		}, ActivePath: input.ActivePath,
	})
}

func buildPlanningReadinessFromDraft(studentID string, draft StudentOnboardingDraft, provenance []StudentPlanningReadinessProvenance, activePath *StudentPlanningReadinessActivePath) (StudentPlanningReadinessSnapshot, error) {
	profile := StudentPlanningReadinessProfile{
		DirectionCode: draft.DirectionCode, SelfAssessedExperience: draft.SelfAssessedExperience,
		KnownStacks: planningReadinessDraftStacks(draft.KnownStacks), DesiredStacks: planningReadinessDraftStacks(draft.DesiredStacks),
		WeeklyMinutes: draft.WeeklyMinutes, PreferredPace: draft.PreferredPace,
	}
	if draft.PreferredLanguage != nil {
		profile.PreferredLanguage = planningReadinessLanguage(*draft.PreferredLanguage, provenance, draft.Version, nil, 0)
		if planningReadinessLanguageTrusted(profile.PreferredLanguage) {
			profile.ContentLanguage = &StudentPlanningReadinessLanguage{Code: profile.PreferredLanguage.Code, Provenance: profile.PreferredLanguage.Provenance, Source: "preferred_language"}
		}
	}
	result := StudentPlanningReadinessSnapshot{
		Schema: StudentPlanningReadinessSnapshotSchema, StudentID: studentID,
		StateRef: StudentPlanningReadinessStateRef{Kind: "accepted_draft", Version: draft.Version},
		Profile:  profile, ActivePath: activePath,
	}
	if draft.GoalCode != nil && *draft.GoalCode == "learn_programming" {
		result.LearningIntent = &StudentPlanningReadinessLearningIntent{
			Code: "learn_programming", Source: "onboarding_goal_code.v1", Provenance: "accepted_student_draft",
		}
	}
	return normalizeStudentPlanningReadiness(result)
}

func buildPlanningReadinessFromProfile(studentID string, profile StudentOnboarding, provenance []StudentPlanningReadinessProvenance, finalizedDraftVersion int64, activePath *StudentPlanningReadinessActivePath) (StudentPlanningReadinessSnapshot, error) {
	known := unresolvedPlanningReadinessStacks()
	if len(profile.KnownStacks) > 0 {
		known = answeredPlanningReadinessStacks(profile.KnownStacks)
	} else if planningReadinessHasMatchingStacks(provenance, StudentOnboardingSlotKnownStacks, profile.KnownStacks, 0, &profile.Version, finalizedDraftVersion) {
		known = answeredPlanningReadinessStacks(profile.KnownStacks)
	}
	desired := answeredPlanningReadinessStacks(profile.DesiredStacks)
	result := StudentPlanningReadinessSnapshot{
		Schema: StudentPlanningReadinessSnapshotSchema, StudentID: studentID,
		StateRef: StudentPlanningReadinessStateRef{Kind: "finalized_profile", Version: profile.Version},
		Profile: StudentPlanningReadinessProfile{
			DirectionCode: &profile.DirectionCode, SelfAssessedExperience: &profile.SelfAssessedExperience,
			KnownStacks: known, DesiredStacks: desired, WeeklyMinutes: &profile.WeeklyMinutes, PreferredPace: &profile.PreferredPace,
			PreferredLanguage: planningReadinessLanguage(profile.PreferredLanguage, provenance, 0, &profile.Version, finalizedDraftVersion),
		}, ActivePath: activePath,
	}
	if planningReadinessLanguageTrusted(result.Profile.PreferredLanguage) {
		result.Profile.ContentLanguage = &StudentPlanningReadinessLanguage{Code: result.Profile.PreferredLanguage.Code, Provenance: result.Profile.PreferredLanguage.Provenance, Source: "preferred_language"}
	}
	if profile.GoalCode == "learn_programming" {
		result.LearningIntent = &StudentPlanningReadinessLearningIntent{
			Code: "learn_programming", Source: "onboarding_goal_code.v1", Provenance: "finalized_profile",
		}
	}
	return normalizeStudentPlanningReadiness(result)
}

func planningReadinessDraftStacks(values *[]string) StudentPlanningReadinessStackValues {
	if values == nil {
		return unansweredPlanningReadinessStacks()
	}
	return answeredPlanningReadinessStacks(*values)
}
func unansweredPlanningReadinessStacks() StudentPlanningReadinessStackValues {
	return StudentPlanningReadinessStackValues{State: "unanswered"}
}
func unresolvedPlanningReadinessStacks() StudentPlanningReadinessStackValues {
	return StudentPlanningReadinessStackValues{State: "unresolved"}
}
func answeredPlanningReadinessStacks(values []string) StudentPlanningReadinessStackValues {
	copied := append([]string{}, values...)
	return StudentPlanningReadinessStackValues{State: "answered", Values: &copied}
}

func planningReadinessLanguage(code string, values []StudentPlanningReadinessProvenance, draftVersion int64, profileVersion *int64, finalizedDraftVersion int64) *StudentPlanningReadinessLanguage {
	for _, value := range values {
		if value.SlotCode != StudentOnboardingSlotPreferredLanguage || value.CodeValue == nil || *value.CodeValue != code || value.Origin != StudentOnboardingTurnOriginExplicitUI && value.Origin != StudentOnboardingTurnOriginExplicitText {
			continue
		}
		// The draft row has one terminal, monotonically increasing lineage. A
		// later accepted turn carries untouched slots forward without inserting
		// duplicate provenance, so the latest exact slot evidence remains valid.
		if draftVersion > 0 && value.AcceptedProfileVersion == nil &&
			value.AcceptedDraftVersion > 0 && value.AcceptedDraftVersion <= draftVersion {
			return &StudentPlanningReadinessLanguage{Code: code, Provenance: string(value.Origin)}
		}
		if profileVersion != nil && value.AcceptedProfileVersion != nil && *value.AcceptedProfileVersion == *profileVersion {
			return &StudentPlanningReadinessLanguage{Code: code, Provenance: string(value.Origin)}
		}
		if profileVersion != nil && finalizedDraftVersion > 0 && value.AcceptedProfileVersion == nil &&
			value.AcceptedDraftVersion > 0 && value.AcceptedDraftVersion <= finalizedDraftVersion {
			return &StudentPlanningReadinessLanguage{Code: code, Provenance: string(value.Origin)}
		}
	}
	return &StudentPlanningReadinessLanguage{Code: code, Provenance: "untrusted_persisted"}
}

func planningReadinessLanguageTrusted(value *StudentPlanningReadinessLanguage) bool {
	return value != nil && (value.Provenance == string(StudentOnboardingTurnOriginExplicitUI) || value.Provenance == string(StudentOnboardingTurnOriginExplicitText))
}

func planningReadinessHasMatchingStacks(values []StudentPlanningReadinessProvenance, slot string, stacks []string, draftVersion int64, profileVersion *int64, finalizedDraftVersion int64) bool {
	for _, value := range values {
		if value.SlotCode != slot || value.StacksValue == nil || len(*value.StacksValue) != len(stacks) {
			continue
		}
		matches := true
		for index := range stacks {
			if (*value.StacksValue)[index] != stacks[index] {
				matches = false
				break
			}
		}
		if !matches {
			continue
		}
		if draftVersion > 0 && value.AcceptedProfileVersion == nil &&
			value.AcceptedDraftVersion > 0 && value.AcceptedDraftVersion <= draftVersion {
			return true
		}
		if profileVersion != nil && value.AcceptedProfileVersion != nil && *value.AcceptedProfileVersion == *profileVersion {
			return true
		}
		if profileVersion != nil && finalizedDraftVersion > 0 && value.AcceptedProfileVersion == nil &&
			value.AcceptedDraftVersion > 0 && value.AcceptedDraftVersion <= finalizedDraftVersion {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

func normalizeStudentPlanningReadiness(input StudentPlanningReadinessSnapshot) (StudentPlanningReadinessSnapshot, error) {
	if input.Schema != StudentPlanningReadinessSnapshotSchema || input.StudentID == "" ||
		(input.StateRef.Kind != "none" && input.StateRef.Kind != "accepted_draft" && input.StateRef.Kind != "finalized_profile") || input.StateRef.Version < 0 ||
		(input.StateRef.Kind == "none" && input.StateRef.Version != 0) || (input.StateRef.Kind != "none" && input.StateRef.Version < 1) {
		return StudentPlanningReadinessSnapshot{}, errors.New("invalid planning readiness snapshot")
	}
	for _, stacks := range []StudentPlanningReadinessStackValues{input.Profile.KnownStacks, input.Profile.DesiredStacks} {
		if (stacks.State != "answered" && stacks.State != "unanswered" && stacks.State != "unresolved") || (stacks.Values != nil && len(*stacks.Values) > 20) || (stacks.State == "answered" && stacks.Values == nil) || (stacks.State != "answered" && stacks.Values != nil) {
			return StudentPlanningReadinessSnapshot{}, errors.New("invalid planning readiness stacks")
		}
	}
	if input.LearningIntent != nil && (input.LearningIntent.Code != "learn_programming" || input.LearningIntent.Source != "onboarding_goal_code.v1" || (input.LearningIntent.Provenance != "accepted_student_draft" && input.LearningIntent.Provenance != "finalized_profile")) {
		return StudentPlanningReadinessSnapshot{}, errors.New("invalid planning readiness intent")
	}
	if input.Profile.PreferredLanguage != nil && (input.Profile.PreferredLanguage.Provenance != "explicit_ui" && input.Profile.PreferredLanguage.Provenance != "explicit_text" && input.Profile.PreferredLanguage.Provenance != "untrusted_persisted") {
		return StudentPlanningReadinessSnapshot{}, errors.New("invalid planning readiness language")
	}
	if input.Profile.ContentLanguage != nil && (!planningReadinessLanguageTrusted(input.Profile.ContentLanguage) || input.Profile.ContentLanguage.Source != "preferred_language" || input.Profile.PreferredLanguage == nil || input.Profile.ContentLanguage.Code != input.Profile.PreferredLanguage.Code || input.Profile.ContentLanguage.Provenance != input.Profile.PreferredLanguage.Provenance) {
		return StudentPlanningReadinessSnapshot{}, errors.New("invalid planning readiness content language")
	}
	if input.ActivePath != nil && (input.ActivePath.LearningPathID == "" || input.ActivePath.Version < 1 || input.ActivePath.CourseID == "" || input.ActivePath.GoalCode == "" || input.ActivePath.Status != "ACTIVE") {
		return StudentPlanningReadinessSnapshot{}, errors.New("invalid planning readiness path")
	}
	return input, nil
}
